_description: System-size convergence for WDM transport coefficients

expected_results.d_inf_tolerance_rationale: Yeh-Hummer D(N)=D_inf+alpha/N^(1/3) fit with noise_std=0.05 and 20 replicas per size; 0.3 is 12% of D_inf=2.5, covering finite-size extrapolation uncertainty from 9 system sizes.
expected_results.alpha_range_rationale: Hydrodynamic correction alpha=2*pi*eta*kBT/(6*pi*L) scales with box size; true value 10.0, range [5,20] covers 2x fitting uncertainty from noise.
expected_results.r_squared_min_rationale: Linear fit D(N) vs N^(-1/3) with 9 points and noise_std=0.05 on D_inf=2.5 should achieve R^2 > 0.99; 0.95 is a conservative floor.
expected_results.extrapolation_relative_error_max_rationa: |D_fit - D_inf| / D_inf < 10%: 20 replicas reduce standard error to ~0.05/sqrt(20) ≈ 0.011, so 10% is a 23x margin.
expected_results.mean_at_largest_n_range_rationale: At N=1e6, D(N) ≈ D_inf + alpha/100 ≈ 2.6; [2.0, 3.5] provides symmetric margin around true D_inf=2.5.
expected_results.residual_std_max_rationale: Fit residuals from 9-point regression with noise_std=0.05 per point; 0.2 is 4x per-point noise, covering any systematic finite-size deviation.
